summary: Frontend-only testing of 2 new calendar enhancements on the meeting-room scheduler. Verified: (1) click-to-create on Dashboard monthly calendar prefills Tanggal with clicked date; form submits and chip appears on that date. (2) Room accent color (left border + translucent bg) applied to chips on both monthly and weekly calendars. (3) Public /jadwal monthly calendar is read-only (no dialog opens, no cursor-pointer). (4) Theme toggle works. (5) Tab switching and all 3 tabs work on both Dashboard and /jadwal. (6) Created test schedule was cleaned up successfully.

issues: Room-color hashing produces collisions: 'Ruhui Rahayu' and 'Olah Bebaya' both resolve to rgb(162,28,175) in the 15-color ROOM_PALETTE. Not strictly broken (same room always same color), but two different rooms can share a color. Consider mapping rooms directly via index of settings.rooms rather than char-hashing to guarantee uniqueness up to palette size.
Pre-existing a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add DialogDescription to the schedule form dialog.

action_items: (Optional) Replace hash-based roomColor with a stable index lookup against settings.rooms to avoid palette collisions between distinct rooms.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription inside schedule-form-dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: roomColor uses char-code hash mod 15: collisions are possible even with few rooms (observed Ruhui Rahayu == Olah Bebaya).
MonthlyCalendar: good - onDateClick only wires click + cursor-pointer when prop is provided; PublicJadwal correctly omits it, keeping it read-only.
ScheduleForm.useEffect correctly resets Tanggal to initialDate on open when not editing.
No console errors on happy path; only pre-existing aria-describedby warning on DialogContent.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST schedule via click-to-create flow (future date in current month, 'TEST_Click_Create_Meeting'); deleted after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both calendar enhancements work. Only minor cosmetic issues (color hash collision + aria-describedby warning). Server date observed ~Oct 11, 2026.
